enchantments.tooltip: Seeker +4: Provides a +4 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +4 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

Sneak Attack Bonus +3 : Provides a +3 Enhancement modifier to your attack bonus and a +5 Enhancement bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.
Overfocus: This item helps you focus your attention, but it makes you somewhat oblivious to your surroundings, causing a -10 penalty to Search and Spot.
